backendOnlyContracts.identifiersOnly: Schema-prefix rules (L-LITERAL-SCHEMA, L-FK-OUTSIDE) check SQL identifiers only; string literals and comments (-- and nested /* */) are ignored (D-RUN-13). Text is prepared by one quote-aware tokenizer pass whose token table is authoritative in SPEC-RWB-E1-044-007. Summary: standard strings '...' with '' as an escaped quote; escape strings E'...', in which a doubled quote ('') and a backslash followed by a quote are each an escaped quote, and two backslashes are one escaped backslash (backslash rules apply only inside E'...'); quoted identifiers "..." with "" ; Flyway ${...} placeholders (never a dollar quote); $$ and $tag$ bodies scanned as code. An unterminated token is L-LEX. Statements are cut from the identifier text at top-level ; tokens, so a comment or string never supplies the statement kind
backendOnlyContracts.findingMultiplicity: One finding per (rule, file, line, key). L-LITERAL-SCHEMA key: the disallowed schema name, whichever items 1-4 match. L-FK-OUTSIDE key: the referenced qualifier. L-SEARCH-PATH and L-GRANT: one per line. L-LEX: one per unterminated opener. A qualified REFERENCES outside ${recoverySchema} gives one L-FK-OUTSIDE and one L-LITERAL-SCHEMA finding (L-FK-OUTSIDE only for information_schema or pg_catalog) (SPEC-RWB-E1-044-004, -008)
backendOnlyContracts.extensionPoint: One rule registry; L-LITERAL-SCHEMA qualifier decision in one method (isAllowedQualifier). Seam SEAM-E044-01 owned by RWB-E1-069: public allowed only inside CREATE [OR REPLACE] VIEW ${recoverySchema}.v_ace_* (not built here). Seam SEAM-E044-02 owned by RWB-E1-069: Section A grants on public hit L-GRANT and L-LITERAL-SCHEMA items 3 and 4 (OI-E044-B)
